segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: This is the postmortem for Tuesday's checkout outage.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: At 14:02 the alert fired for checkout errors, and we paged the on-call engineer.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: At 14:20 we rolled back the config change and checkout recovered at 14:25.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Impact: about two thousand customers couldn't pay for twenty-three minutes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: The root cause was a config change that set the payment timeout to zero.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_02
segments.text: I'll add validation so the timeout can't be set below one second, by next Friday.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: And I'll update the change review checklist to include config values.
